raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation With `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec` on a KDA model, `commit_mamba_states_after_verify` takes the KDA ReplaySSM branch on every verify. That branch recomputed `last_correct_step_indices` and `mamba_steps_to_track` with about 17 eager kernel launches per step, although the verify commit already fuses both into `prepared_step_indices` (`prepare_verify_commit_outputs`) and the GDN ReplaySSM branches use them. On GLM-5.3-Flash MTP 5/1/6 the host is already the bottleneck with this flag, so the extra launches delay every verify. ## Modifications - The KDA ReplaySSM branch takes `prepared_step_indices` when given and otherwise calls `_verify_commit_step_indices`, like the two GDN ReplaySSM branches. Both compute the same values as the removed eager code. - The idle / empty-batch early return and the choice between prepared and recomputed indices now run once, before the branch dispatch, instead of in each of the four branches. ## Accuracy Tests GLM-5.3-Flash with the cookbook GB300 recipe plus `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec`. sgl-eval 0.1.2 GSM8K, 200 examples, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on. | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | GSM8K | 96.5% | 97.5% | | Greedy 2,048-token output | | identical token ids | | Accept length, that request | 4.35 | 4.35 | `test_ngram_mamba_verify_update.py`, `test_kda_replayssm_fold.py`, `test_kda_replayssm_fold_batched.py`, `test_kda_fused_verify_backend.py`: 19 passed (21 subtests) on GB300. ## Speed Tests and Profiling GLM-5.3-Flash, 4× GB300, `--tp-size 4`, trtllm DSA, fp8_e4m3 KV, `flashinfer_trtllm` MoE, EAGLE 5/1/6, `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec`, greedy, 2,048 output tokens. Accept length pinned with `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=5 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token` (5.00 on every run). | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | `fwd_occupancy`, concurrency 1 / 8 / 32 | 91.91 / 93.77 / 92.13% | 92.78 / 94.24 / 92.48% | | Per-request decode, concurrency 1 / 8 / 32 | 642 / 383 / 248 tok/s | 648 / 385 / 249 tok/s | nsys, batch size 1, medians over ~150–165 steps: | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | Eager kernels per step | 81.0 | 64.3 | | Host loop per step | 9,610 µs | 9,020 µs | | Gap: verify → draft-extend | 271 µs | 205 µs | | GPU idle per step | 1,567 µs | 1,286 µs | The verify → draft-extend gap of the median step (by that gap), same 320 µs scale, starting 40 µs before the verify graph ends: **Before:** the eager index recompute runs ahead of the `kda_replayssm` commit kernel, which starts at ~197 µs; draft-extend starts at ~311 µs. **After:** the recompute is gone; the commit kernel starts at ~130 µs and draft-extend at ~245 µs. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #38678550294](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38678550294) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38678550103](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38678550103) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38678550086](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38678550086)
